column1: # v3.87 — the frames a person has looked at, at full size, and cleared
# write a screenshot containing a frame that is not on this list.
# It exists because no face detector on this machine can certify the
# demo footage.  `make_demo_clip.py`'s containment check was read as
# "no face escaped" and does not say that: on one frame of the v3.77
# clip the detector returned two boxes, both on the subject's coat and
# neither on her face, containment passed at 100%, and the face was
# legible and unfrosted.  Both on-disk models miss that face entirely —
# BlazeFace finds the coat, FaceLandmarker finds nothing.  So the gate
# is a person, and this file is the record of what they looked at.
# The key is the sha256 of the frame JPEG, not its name: a re-cut clip
# renumbers its frames, and `frame_000019` before and after a re-cut are
# different pictures.  Re-cut the clip and this list must be redone.
# Screening standard (CLAUDE.md): by eye at >= 1400 px, plus a
# native-resolution look wherever a human figure appears.
# `face_count == 0` is not evidence of no face.
